capabilities.write_rejection_hint: For lithium batteries communicating with the BMS, this model's manual (F2, programs 05/07/08, page 19) specifies that OP1 Off-Grid SOC Protection (07) must be at least 1 percentage point below Low DC Protection SOC in Grid Mode (05), no higher than 95%, and no lower than the OP2 cut-off SOC (08). Check these related protection settings; the rejection alone does not confirm which condition failed. Do not change other protection thresholds automatically.
